description: Rinne, Erkka and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The deposit estimates capacity factors for six Vestas turbine types at four hub heights: 75, 100, 125 and 150 metres. It uses Finnish Wind Atlas Weibull distributions and directional frequencies on a 2.5 km grid. Power curves are smoothed to approximate variation between turbines in a farm. The resulting values are simulated resource/technology comparisons, not measured plant output. The source explains the calculation and coordinate file; it does not establish project-specific losses or operational availability for every proposed wind farm. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
